label: Text 1
transcript: Sam and Lina are at the station with three large rucksacks. The train is delayed by twelve minutes. They have read every poster on the platform twice. Mr. Flint has bought tea from a small kiosk and looks suspiciously content. "This," he says, "is the proper way to start a journey."
